mapper.select: SELECT member_id, login_id, password, mem_nm, nick_nm, mem_type, role_cd, join_dt, phone_no, addr, addr_detail, del_yn, reg_dt, reg_id, reg_ip, mod_dt, mod_id, mod_ip FROM member ORDER BY member_id DESC

SELECT member_id, login_id, password, mem_nm, nick_nm, mem_type, role_cd, join_dt, phone_no, addr, addr_detail, del_yn, reg_dt, reg_id, reg_ip, mod_dt, mod_id, mod_ip FROM member WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET mem_nm = #{memNm}, nick_nm = #{nickNm}, phone_no = #{phoneNo}, addr = #{addr}, addr_detail = #{addrDetail} WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND del_yn = 'N'
